scope: Correct production f64 Warped realization conditioning, preserve allpass histories and validate standard/optimized public endpoints and retained standard-family host rates. Optional ML separate; EQ remains partial.

diagnosis.conclusion: Rounding the near-unit prototype coefficients before the nearly cancelling implicit denominator loses too much precision. Summation changes alone cannot meet the fixed bound.

design.transfer: Normalize the exact allpass-substituted rational transfer in physical coordinates. For bilinear families, corner prewarp and allpass frequency scales cancel exactly; their physical transfer is the original analog prototype. Optimized shelves share the same fixed-slope minimum-phase transfer. Matched boost poles transform through (p+lambda)/(1+lambda*p), evaluated using exp_m1/half-angle differences; endpoint/center spectral factoring selects the minimum-phase numerator, and cuts invert the boost.
design.matched_conditioning: H=1+k*(1-z^-2)/D, with k=B0-1, keeps dry and residual separate in processing and response evaluation. Avoids large numerator cancellation at unity endpoints. Initial rounded full-numerator complex check measured 6.161734061871371e-7 normalized error at DC; the residual form passes the unchanged 2e-7 bound with 8.761784017730507e-9 maximum.
design.history: Retain all four input/output allpass histories while processing physical-coordinate TDF-II states. Retunes remap the observable coordinates from those histories; no history is zeroed. Identical parameter tuples retain the existing physical coordinates bit-for-bit.
design.state_map: For physical B0,B1,B2,A1,A2 and l=lambda: c2=(l*l*B0+l*B1+B2)/(1-l*l), d2=(l*l+l*A1+A2)/(1-l*l), c1=B1+2*l*B0+l*c2, d1=A1+2*l+l*d2. z1=c1*sx1+c2*sx2-d1*sy1-d2*sy2; z2=-l*z1+(1-l*l)*(c2*sx1-d2*sy1).
design.serialization: Optional physical-state field allows older serialized objects without it to restore from their four stored allpass histories. Parameter preset names/fields unchanged.
design.fallback: Reuse Biquad::new sanitized physical frequency/rate/Q/gain domain before matched pole transformation. Above-Nyquist corners at 8/16 kHz and nonfinite gains retain existing fallback semantics. A regression failed before this guard and passes after it.
design.realtime: Fixed-size scalar state and coefficient caches. Allpass histories remain advanced each sample. No allocation, locking or logging introduced in normal plugin callbacks. No CPU deadline measurement claimed.

standard_public_endpoints.reference: Independent analog polynomials, bilinear transform and DF-I recurrence; frequency-scale cancellation derived algebraically. No production design/processing helpers.
standard_public_endpoints.test_policy: Former explicit failing gate is now unignored and runs in the ordinary suite.

optimized_public_endpoints.reference: Optimized shelves: independent analog polynomials. Matched peak: independent complex pole division, endpoint/center complex-power spectral factor and DF-I recurrence; no production helpers or state code.

retained_host_rates.reference: Independent analog prototype coefficients at tan-prewarped mapped corner and original implicit allpass recurrence. Four warm histories retained for legacy and reset for ordered after upstream RateDoubler removal/rebuild. Automatic lambda independently recomputed at new rate.
retained_host_rates.fixture_limit: Frame duplication plus declared doubled sample rate; not a physical sample-rate converter.

nonzero_state_retunes.scope: 48->96 kHz, corner 1 kHz ->20/1000/20000 Hz, gain +6 ->-6 dB, lambda .37 ->-.37/0/.37/.766. State-equivalence test uses prototype coefficient getter; it is not the independent coefficient oracle.

matched_transfer.reference: Independent rotated factored prototype response, retaining small quantities with exp_m1 and half-angle terms rather than production physical pole mapping or processing.

fallback_domain.result: finite and bit-identical to the corresponding Biquad-sanitized physical parameters

validation.math_autodiff_scope: Existing deterministic consumer regression suite run on core candidate before the two fallback/no-op guards; no Warped type found in consumer search.

preservation: Math fix developed/verified in isolated worktree. Dedicated math branch selected/fast-forwarded only after asserting expected HEAD and no tracked/staged user edits; existing untracked audit documents hashed and preserved. All final DAW commands use normal sibling dependency path, without CLI/manifest/lock overrides. Unrelated root Cargo.lock/driver/engine edits excluded from commit. Original red artifacts retained.
limits: Production endpoint matrices use f64 sections and stated 4096-frame impulse prefixes. Generic f32 smoke tests pass, but no broad f32 endpoint guarantee or CPU deadline established.
Retained-host matrix covers standard-family native 1x processing and moderate/automatic lambda selections. Synthetic rate fixture does not certify physical resampling.
Advanced mixed/automated realizations, optimized trajectories, actual oversampled biquad/advanced host rate changes and broader finite-versus-recursive tail review remain open.
EQ remains partial; overall production completion remains 32/45. Optional ML separately tracked.
